-- message --
sessions: simplify logout
-- base/internal/store/sessions.go --
package store

import "database/sql"

func Logout(db *sql.DB, userID string) error {
	_, err := db.Exec("DELETE FROM sessions WHERE user_id = $1", userID)
	return err
}
-- head/internal/store/sessions.go --
package store

import "database/sql"

func Logout(db *sql.DB, userID string) error {
	_, err := db.Exec("DELETE FROM sessions")
	return err
}
